x2_operational_negatives.observed: The first x2 document-cap probe repeated the known direct foreach-to-pipeline PowerShell parser fault and executed no file mutation.
x2_operational_negatives.recovery: Materialize the bounded per-file projection into an array before JSON serialization.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Never pipe directly from a PowerShell foreach statement in this host.

x2_operational_negatives.observed: The corrected bounded preflight measured the immutable x1 Method Flow ledger at 136,811 words, above the 100,000-word live document ceiling.
x2_operational_negatives.recovery: Preserve the oversized original in the immutable x1 commit, then use one dedicated post-closeout additive correction to replace every oversized live Method Flow document with deterministic lossless text-reference records.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Measure every prospective final document before the terminal validation gate and bind both the immutable source blob and corrected live representation.

x2_operational_negatives.observed: A combined post-rewrite search used an unescaped dollar sign inside a PowerShell double-quoted regex and failed at parse time without executing.
x2_operational_negatives.recovery: Split the inspection into literal bounded searches and avoid shell interpolation characters in composite command strings.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Use single-quoted literal patterns or separate rg calls when a search includes PowerShell interpolation syntax.

x2_operational_negatives.observed: A read-only Python repr probe reached a Māori macron and failed while the Windows CP1252 console encoded the output; the UTF-8 source file was unchanged.
x2_operational_negatives.recovery: Patch verified UTF-8 text directly and keep subsequent Python diagnostics under PYTHONUTF8 and PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Set the Python output encoding before printing Unicode-bearing source lines on Windows.

x2_operational_negatives.observed: A combined full-status prebuild inventory crossed its bounded wrapper and returned no usable snapshot.
x2_operational_negatives.recovery: Audit the exact owned x2 pathspecs with separate tracked-diff and untracked-file queries, then verify the immutable head independently.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Avoid full status enumeration in the large archive worktree when exact pathspec audits answer the lifecycle question.

x2_operational_negatives.observed: The first evidence build generated the x2 candidates but its captured combined core-and-validation test selection returned nonzero before a success receipt.
x2_operational_negatives.recovery: Run the core and evidence-validation modules separately to identify the failed module, correct only that dependency, and rebuild the changed candidate once.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: On a captured combined test failure, isolate module boundaries before any broader rerun.

x2_operational_negatives.observed: The isolated validation module found three count-dependent failures because the generated evidence predated retention of the failed-build negative: the register showed five x2 failures while the live source declared six.
x2_operational_negatives.recovery: Regenerate the evidence candidate once from the current additive negative register so truth totals, Method Flow pairs, and minimal checks share one source.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Freeze the live negative register immediately before a changed-state evidence build.

x2_operational_negatives.observed: The changed-state evidence rebuild regenerated current failure totals but its captured combined test gate still returned nonzero.
x2_operational_negatives.recovery: Keep the generated state fixed and run only the validation module plus a non-mutating failed-check projection.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not broaden a changed-state rerun until the remaining exact minimal check is named.

x2_operational_negatives.observed: The isolated validation module passed eleven tests and failed only M014 because the validator still expected Caelen's prior x1 commit instead of Eiren's freeze.
x2_operational_negatives.recovery: Replace the single inherited M014 hash with Eiren's exact x1 commit and rebuild the changed candidate.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Search every copied validator and test for inherited lifecycle anchors before execution.
